rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server implementation by Shen-zhihao that provides AI assistants with web-based security audit capabilities for Node.js projects, featuring vulnerability scanning, dependency analysis, and markdown report generation. The implementation analyzes both local and remote projects by parsing package.json files, running npm audit commands, and normalizing vulnerability data into structured reports categorized by severity levels (critical, high, moderate, low). Built with EJS templating for customizable report formatting and supporting both current project auditing and remote repository analysis, it streamlines security assessment workflows for development teams who need automated vulnerability detection and professional audit documentation without manual security analysis.
